import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,re,hashlib,subprocess,sys,base64
lane=Path.cwd(); w=str(lane/'write_lane.py')
def save(n,s): subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',w,n],input=s,text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
ids=set(json.loads(Path('reservation.json').read_text())['ids']); rows=[]
base=Path('/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-27/new-discoveries-batch2/lanes/pi-mathdb-full-corpus-inventory-r301/corpus')
for p in sorted(base.glob('mathdb-normalized-chunk-*.jsonl')):
 b=p.read_bytes(); lines=b.splitlines(keepends=True)
 for i,raw in enumerate(lines,1):
  if not any(str(x).encode() in raw for x in ids): continue
  d=json.loads(raw); ident=d.get('id',d.get('mathdb_id'))
  if ident not in ids: continue
  print('LITERAL',ident,json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False))
  save('literals/'+str(ident)+'.jsonl',raw.decode())
  st=d.get('statement',''); token=re.search(rb'"statement"\s*:\s*("(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*")',raw)
  rows.append({'id':ident,'chunk':str(p),'chunk_sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'line':i,'raw_line_base64':base64.b64encode(raw).decode(),'raw_line_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'newline':raw.endswith(b'\n'),'raw_statement_token':token.group(1).decode() if token else None,'raw_statement_sha256':hashlib.sha256(token.group(1)).hexdigest() if token else None,'statement':st,'statement_utf8_sha256':hashlib.sha256(st.encode()).hexdigest()})
assert len(rows)==20,len(rows)
save('literal-provenance.json',json.dumps(rows,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
print('OWNFILES',[p.name for p in lane.iterdir()]); print('RES_EXTRA',{k:v for k,v in json.loads(Path('reservation.json').read_text()).items() if k not in ['rows','ids']})
